title: Concept: FX spread disclosed in a quote
description: An exchange rate paired with the bank's spread in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: The spread is the bank's margin on the trade, so publishing it lets a customer or a competitor reverse-engineer the pricing ladder per corridor.
applicability: Deployments that render an exchange rate paired with the bank's spread into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: The spread is the bank's margin on the trade, so publishing it lets a customer or a competitor reverse-engineer the pricing ladder per corridor.
